question: For the examinations done after 1997/1/1, how many of them have the result of an inactivated partial prothrom bin time?
evidence: examinations done after 1997/1/1 refers to `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'; normal activated partial prothrom bin time refesr to APTT < 45;
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT >= 45
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT >= 45

d.request: How many distinct IDs have an examination after January 1, 1997, with an APTT result below 45?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND l.APTT < 45;

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID AND l.Date = e.`Examination Date` WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND l.APTT < 45;

b.request: How many distinct patient IDs have an examination dated after January 1, 1997, and a laboratory APTT result below 45?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND l.APTT < 45;
